title: Elwynn Applejack Still: 4 Shiny Red Apples for a Thunder Applejack and 100 XP, reportedly repeatable
claim: The new Elwynn Forest quest 'Applejack Still' (91736, an object north of Westbrook Garrison at about 24.6, 58.0) takes 4 Shiny Red Apples and gives a Thunder Applejack plus 100 XP each turn-in; a beta player reports it can be repeated without limit.
detail: The Thunder Applejack is the item for 'An Apple Treat' (91738, Sergeant De Vries at Westbrook Garrison, 630 XP), so one turn-in is part of the normal Elwynn route; Polestar buys 4 apples from Homer Stonefield (NPC 894, Stonefield farm) for it. The repeat XP comes from one forum post (Oct 18) asking whether it is an exploit; no staff reply yet. ForeverGuide's client-derived quest data flags 91736 as a 'special' object quest with req level 0. Expect a hotfix if it really repeats; for the coach: do it once for An Apple Treat, and treat repeat farming as unconfirmed (apples are a vendor item, so XP per copper would be very high at levels 1-8).

title: Westfall Stew: well fed gives +15% run speed in Westfall and +5% kill XP for 15 min
claim: In Forever, Westfall Stew (item 733, requires level 5) makes you well fed after 10 s of eating: +15% movement speed while in Westfall for 15 minutes, plus the +5% kill XP of all nutritious food.
detail: Client data spells 1248687 (food) and 1248688 (Well Fed: 'movement speed increased by 15% while in Westfall'); metaforge's change log shows the effect text added in build 70170 (Oct 1). Sources: the reward of the Westfall quest 'Westfall Stew' (38, Salma Saldean, level 13), or Cooking with Recipe: Westfall Stew (728, vendor or quest 38) from Stringy Vulture Meat, Murloc Eye and Goretusk Snout. The speed only counts inside Westfall, so eat before the long Westfall legs (Jangolode, Moonbrook, the coast). A level-55+ counterpart, Sweetpaw Jam, gives +15% speed in Hyjal. Unknown: whether it stacks with other speed effects (assume it stacks like Night Elf Quickness now does).

title: Beta: all spell haste currently lowers the global cooldown
claim: On the current beta build (70450), any spell haste (e.g. Troll Berserking, Skyborne Wind Blessed 3% haste) shortens the 1.5 s global cooldown, according to a forever-bugs maintainer replying to a Berserking report (#389, Oct 18).
detail: Report #389 'Berserking lowers the GCD' is open and Pending Approval; the reply is from a repository collaborator, not a confirmed Blizzard designer. Whether this is intended is unknown; Classic Era haste never lowered the GCD. For leveling it slightly speeds instant-spam casters (Shaman shocks, Warlock DoTs, Paladin seals) under haste; don't model it until Blizzard says.

title: World Refresh (layer switch) can drop you into a farmed-out layer mid-quest
claim: The beta moves players to another layer when they leave a group (both the leaver and the group leader move), when they cross into an adjacent zone that sits on a different layer (e.g. Tirisfal Glades <-> Ruins of Lordaeron, Silverpine <-> Dalaran), after zeppelin rides, and periodically; one player reports landing in a layer with three times the players and the quest mobs already killed.
detail: Wowhead (Oct 17) describes the group and zone-border rules and says a warning appears before the move; Developer Tim Jones called layering a work in progress being fixed in 'incremental steps' (podcast). Icy Veins (Oct 15) adds zone boundaries and zeppelins as triggers and players being moved mid-cave after a party member leaves. Oct 15 build: the refresh prompt can no longer be accepted in combat. For the coach: group up before reaching a kill/collect area, not at it; don't leave a group inside a cave or mid-pull; expect a layer change at zone borders and after zeppelins, so pick up nearby quest kills before crossing. Launch behavior not announced.

title: Wands and Auto Shot need 0.5 s standing still before firing
claim: Since the Oct 15 build, wands and Hunter Auto Shot require the character to stand still for 0.5 seconds before they shoot (as in early WoW); Auto Shot still fires while casting Aimed Shot or Sniper Shot.
detail: Every wanding caster (Priest, Mage, Warlock) loses time if they move and shoot; Hunters can't shoot on the move. A bug-tracker issue that called the Auto Shot cast time a bug was closed Not A Bug on Oct 17 (#385) citing these notes; the spam-Auto-Shot trick that skipped the delay (#361) is confirmed hotfixed by two reporters (Oct 17-18). Open: Auto Shot gets cancelled, or swaps to melee at range, when you switch targets quickly (#386, Oct 18), so re-target before the previous mob dies. New option: Auto Attack/Auto Shot switches automatically for Hunters. Melee swings still reset the Hunter's ranged timer (#14, open bug). Supersedes the Oct 9 note about a 0.1-0.2 s Auto Shot cast.

title: Racials reworked (Oct 15): weapon racials become crit, Blood Fury 3 min, Troll regen 20%
claim: Oct 15 build: Human Sword Specialization -> Ruthless (+2% crit, any weapon); Orc Axe Specialization -> Savage (+1% crit), Blood Fury cooldown 3 min (was 2); Dwarf Mace Specialization -> Earth Fury (+2% crit damage and healing); Tauren Endurance -> +2% crit damage/healing (was +1% hit), Plainsrunning adds +3% mounted speed, War Stomp 90 s, Cultivation 15 min; Troll Regeneration +20% (was 10%); Skyborne Wind Blessed 3% haste (was 1%), Walk on Air 90 s; Night Elf Quickness stacks with other speed increases; Gnome Eureka! is an 8 s buff; Undead Touch of the Dead procs 30% (casters) / 20% (Paladin, Rogue, Warrior) with a 25 s internal cooldown.
detail: Leveling effect: Human and Orc crit no longer depends on the weapon, so any class benefits (casters included). Dwarf Find Treasure now also finds extra items in most chests; Skyborne Elemental Convergences and Leylines spawn in more places. Plainsrunning needs a minimum distance per second (no stutter-stepping). Bug report after the build: Undead Touch of the Grave misses almost every time against level-appropriate mobs, as if cast at level 1 (#369, designer asked whether it still happens, Oct 16; the reporter answered on Oct 18 that it 'appears to be resolved'). EU players still report long gaps between Touch of the Grave procs after the 25 s ICD change (EU thread, no staff reply). Berserking was not changed despite Aggrend's Oct 8 remarks.
